In-game verification on MCBETestServer (BDS 1.26.45, Endstone 0.11.10,
arc_core 0.9.71, arc_ai_helper 2.4.0):

- Assistant persistent body (TianXing) via arc_ai_helper keepalive ->

  (8 s) game-mode switch -> stable across keepalive cycles (no re-spawn spam
  after the stale-handle fix in _live_actor/_live_external).
- bot:drop: replaceitem 10 iron_ingot, dropped 5 -> ITEM_ON_GROUND confirmed.
- /ai money TianXing 500 then query -> wallet 500.00 through arc_core Economy.
- /ai auto on + status: scheduler reports 4 cards, target 3, and correctly
  refuses to spawn while LLM is unconfigured (single warning).
- No fall damage on high-air bootstrap since the delayed gamemode switch.

Not covered in-game: LLM-driven crowd bot behaviour and give_item/pay_money
tool paths (no API key available on the test machine); covered by unit tests
